[star] Forced Response: After The Punisher activates against you, he also attacks each minion engaged with you. Those attacks cannot be defended, are not made against a player and ignore each "Boost" ability. Minions cannot attack or stun him.
Forced Response: After an ally or enemy is defeated by The Punisher or by an encounter card, place 1 war counter on War on Crime.
